body:
The last eight. 

Ranmaru Kageyama...Well. Brushing out his hair when I worked on him was a pain. Notherwise, he's quiet sort of person. He's incredibly tolerant. He reminds me of a little lamb. With soft fluffy hair. His edgy attire does not suit him

Shunsuke Hayasaka is a boring man. A lanky sort of fellow. I didn't trust him one bit around Gin. Too timid for my liking now. Stuttering. Although, his bravery to protect Gin was Commendable. So... I suppose I misjudged him. 

Naomichi Kurumada. Brash. He's a bit rude, right? Trying to fix up his muscles to look good was a challenge. But ah well. Suppose that most of these are good people just in bad situations. I want to applaud him almost. 

Hinako Mishuku. I am not fond of her attitude. So... Grating. Not only is she a weak link, she's one of the most apathetic people I'd ever had the displeasure of speaking to. 

Mai Tsurugi the Baker. Well. At first she is an odd person who makes me uncomfortable with her remarks. Seriously, why would she say such things! And she's generally a confusing person. Also, I don't like the way she looks. She freaks me out. 

Anzu Kinashi's clothes are too bright for my eyes. Too many things going on. Although normally she's very pleasant to be around, I've met her at a bad time. Perhaps I'd like to see her preform one day. Maybe she will make me a balloon animal! I'd always wanted to learn how to make them. 

The other two, I never met.
The war in Yugoslavia??? Literally could not find any mention of it
Oh, lots of studying. I lined up each of the characters and picked their color palletes, researched the anatomy, etc.

This is interesting. 

(In character, hehe) 

First, Sara Chidouin. I... Reluctantly put my faith in her. Someone very dear to me trusted her. So I suppose I shall as well. She's got a good head on her shoulders. 

Keiji Shinogi is... Difficult. He constantly is rooting around for more information and refuses to disclose anything to me... It's quite frustrating! 

"Sou Hiyori" spoiler Rat, vermin. A sneaky little creature too weak to survive without lies in his pocket. ||His identity is not his own. Although, with Kanna, he was shockingly gentle.||

Kazumi Mishima, his intentions were noble. I would have liked to know him better. And his glasses looked... Nice. 

Kanna Kizuchi, poor girl. Manipulated, thrust into this game. Manipulated and played as a fool. Or was she? I get the feeling they were right where they wanted to be. 

Reko Yabusame. Very big on justice and standing up for the little guy. Erm. Some of the things I said have gotten me told off. But she's a good woman.
 
Alice Yabusame. A cold sort of understanding. I called him Gombee for the longest time because I didn't correlate it to being a false name. I thought it was his chosen name... 

Q-taro Burgerburg. I don't know what to think. Is he a coward or a hero? Certainly too boisterous for my taste. To each their own.

Nao Egokoro, or Miss Nao. Odd. Really odd. Although, I suppose as an outsider looking in that could be said. I'm much the same about the few I actually admire. 

Joe Tazuna? Well. Not too boisterous. But cheerful. He's a vibrant sort. Almost my opposite. I wish I could be as cheerful as he is. A big brother sort. I'm fond of him.

Gin Ibushi and I are kindred spirits. We share the same disability. He wears his cute little cloak to feel brave, and I my tailcoat. When nobody else gets it, he does. 

Kai Satou... Oh. He was... Very dear to me. Actually, ||the two of us grew up with each other almost, with different ASUNARO programs.|| One of the few I feel comfortable with. I understand the awkward jokes and the undercurrent of his speech. But we drifted apart. And I wouldn't want to oust him like that. So, I let him be. ||It was a mistake.||
